title: Erasing the copied tape symbol
statement: Let $\mathrm{buffer}(w)$ denote the tape containing the word $w$ from cell zero onward, and let $T(p,r)$ be the tape that is blank before cell $|p|$ and otherwise contains $p$ followed by $r$. For Boolean words $p,r$ and a Boolean symbol $b$, erasing cell $|p|$ from $T(p,b::r)$ gives exactly $T(p++[b],r)$.
